memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Migraine
  - Status: 4-5 headache days/month, mild-moderate, sumatriptan used SOS.
  - Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD, sumatriptan 50 mg SOS, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS PRN; headache diary.
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: Worry most days, GAD-7 10 (mild).
  - Plan: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD; monitor for side effects.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure-free 6 months on levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
  - Plan: Continue same; check serum sodium and creatinine.
Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut-off 80 cm, slightly elevated).
Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: low‑glycemic, protein‑rich.
  - Lunch: balanced plate with vegetables.
  - Dinner: light, early.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Migraine
  - Status: Headache days 1/month, sumatriptan used once.
  - Plan: Maintain propranolol 60 mg OD; consider tapering topiramate if drowsiness persists.
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: GAD-7 6 (mild), occasional restless nights.
  - Plan: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, reduce buspirone to 5 mg OD (morning) to lessen daytime fatigue.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure‑free, sodium/creatinine within range.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; repeat labs in 6 months.
Weight 66 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut‑off).
Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: Greek yogurt, fruit.
  - Lunch: mixed vegetable curry, brown rice.
  - Dinner: steamed fish, greens.
